messages:
ingrid (auditor): Need evidence bundle for new inference-routing service: RBAC change history, MFA enforcement proof for owners, KMS key usage logs (last 30d) for service principal, vuln-triage summary, and emergency key access runbook. Deadline Mon 07:00 PST. Mark sensitive items.
meera (sec-eng): Understood. Prod+staging? Raw CloudTrail or CSV?
sam (infra): Prod+staging. I'll produce a CSV extract for 2024-11-01..2024-11-30 for alias/rw-infer-routing. ARN: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123:alias/rw-infer-routing.
liz (devops): RBAC change in PR 4930 (role: rw-infer-run). Approved 2024-11-06. Scoped perms: kms:Decrypt, kms:GenerateDataKey, s3:GetObject model-bucket/*, ecs:RunTask. No iam:* or kms:CreateKey.
meera (sec-eng): MFA: service owners in IdP group 'sec-service-owners'; Conditional Access policy CA-PrivOps-MFA enforced since 2024-08-15. Will attach policy ID.
jordan (oncall): Splunk query used to extract events: index=prod_kms arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123:alias/rw-infer-routing (Decrypt OR GenerateDataKey) | table _time,user,src_ip,eventName | head 500. Will redact IPs for public bundle.
ingrid (auditor): Include sample decrypt event and a RotateKey/Rotate event. Also need statement that service principal has no admin rights and emergency access runbook link.
sam (infra): Sample Decrypt: 2024-11-11T09:14:03Z Decrypt user=arn:aws:sts::123:assumed-role/rw-infer-run/service-account keyId=alias/rw-infer-routing. Rotation recorded in s3://redwood-audit/kms-rotations/ with index.
liz (devops): I'll add IAM diff from PR 4930 and a short least-privilege statement. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kms-emergency-access (SSO required).
meera (sec-eng): Vulnerability triage (30d): 1 medium (outdated base image, CVE-2024-xxxx) fixed 2024-11-19, ticket SEC-2024-214 closed. No open high/critical issues.
ingrid (auditor): Confirm retention for KMS logs and golden copy location; flag sensitive files in bundle.
sam (infra): Golden copy: s3://redwood-audit/golden/kms/ with 7-year retention (governed). Export is a 30-day slice. Marking logs restricted.
meera (sec-eng): We'll produce a ZIP with README mapping items to SOC2 CC6.1 and ISO A.9.2.2, redact IPs for public copy, full set via SFTP: sftp://auditor-upload.redwood/5909876543-infer-evidence.
jordan (oncall): security-bot note: KMS canary alert on 2024-11-20 03:12 UTC was a canary test; no followup.
ingrid (auditor): Good. Upload by Mon 07:00 PST. Thanks. :thumbsup:
meera (sec-eng): Will upload and report back here when complete.
security-bot: Incident bot: no incidents for inference-routing in last 90 days.
